explanation: It is 0 at every GO and D2 step and is only active at D1: at D1 it is about 10 early in the episode (roughly trials 1-10) when the previous trial was rewarded, and 0 or 7-8 after an unrewarded one. Its D1 values then fade with time in the episode, to about 6 around trials 20-30, about 3 around trials 40-50 and 0 after about trial 55, with occasional unexplained 0s right after a rewarded trial, often one where the previous move was a rare transition.
